title: Methodological Convergence in Stage-IV Cosmology: The Emergence of Epistemic Holism Under Precision Constraints, and Its Operationalization via RCMP
description: This note documents a 2023–2026 methodological convergence across cosmic shear, gravitational-slip (EG) estimation, and dark-energy inference: leading analyses now report results with explicit proxy-chain and nuisance-model dependence. The paper interprets this as the practical emergence of Duhem–Quine epistemic holism under Stage-IV precision and highlights RCMP as a concrete operationalization, while making no claims about supporting or disfavouring EFC. It outlines that forthcoming quantitative EFC tests should be conducted at the phenomenological (μ, Σ) level for likelihood compatibility.

key_results.main_finding: Independent Stage-IV analyses now explicitly condition key cosmological inferences (S8, EG, dark-energy hints) on proxy-chain and nuisance-model choices, consistent with RCMP-style reporting under precision constraints.
parameters_tested: S8 framing under IA and baryonic-feedback models
EG estimator dependence on velocity-reconstruction templates
μ(k,z), Σ(k,z) phenomenological modifiers (test plan only)
datasets_used: DESI DR2 (dark energy, SN dependence noted)

sealed_predictions.statement: Rubin DP2 weak-lensing will infer S8 = 0.847 under RCMP-compliant analysis.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Rubin LSST DP2 cosmic-shear pipeline delivering an RCMP-compliant S8 measurement (with documented IA and baryonic-feedback modeling) that is statistically inconsistent with 0.847.

kill_criteria: KC1: If Stage-IV weak-lensing analyses (e.g., DES Y6 reanalysis, KiDS-Legacy, Rubin DP2, or Euclid Y1) report S8 results that are invariant to intrinsic-alignment and baryonic-feedback model choices within their quoted statistical uncertainties, thereby demonstrating model-independence and contradicting the claimed trend toward explicit proxy dependence.

KC2: If EG measurements using independent velocity reconstructions (e.g., RSD-derived β vs. kSZ-reconstructed velocities) yield mutually consistent results with negligible template dependence and confirm the GR-invariance of EG across methods, reversing the reported move to re-evaluate estimator assumptions.

KC3: If DESI DR2+ dark-energy evolution constraints become robust to the supernova compilation choice (i.e., consistent across SN datasets within statistical errors without requiring dataset-dependent caveats), eliminating the reported explicit dataset dependence.

KC4: If broad Stage-IV flagship papers revert to presenting key cosmological parameters as model-independent point estimates without proxy-chain documentation, contrary to RCMP-style coordinate humility and proxy accounting.

related_packages.role: RCMP framework: 5-point checklist and operational protocol referenced as an operationalization of the observed convergence
EFC overview referenced for context; action-level parameters (K0, V′, α) noted as separate from phenomenological (μ, Σ)
